nom: Beekman 1802 Milk Scrub Oat and Goat Milk Exfoliating Facial Cleanser

avis.titre: please bring back exfoliating jelly cleanser
avis.texte: the oat and goat milk exfoliating cleanser is ok; however, really missing the exfoliating jelly cleanser which was a star performer.

I was really excited for this scrub after trying several products from the brand. It is creamy and it doesnt smell too strong. However the exfoliation is TOO gentle (as in, it doesnt actually exfoliate) and the beads are so so annoying to wash off. I can rinse my face multiple times and go over it with a wet rag and still there are beads. Luckily that means I actually get some exfoliation with the rag as I try to get all these beads off! Never have not liked a face scrub before, but this is just not it.

I really like this facial cleanser. It has a nice subtle scent that isn't too strong. The cleanser doesn't irritate my skin and leaves it soft and moisturized. I purchased this when it was on sale but would not normally buy this product at the regular price since I think this brand/product is over-priced.

I like the after glow, pleasant smell, and not too drying. I expect some drying with exfoliating products. the thing keeping me from buying again is the exfoliating beads, they got stuck in my hairline and were just a bit of an annoyance rinsing away.

This scrub is so amazing! It's like using lotion with your cleanser because most cleansers dry your skin and because this has goat's milk it's completely moisturizing, refreshing and if you have sensitive skin like me it's perfect!
This scrub from Beekmens is amazing I use it twice a week and I can see the difference in my skin

avis.titre: Creamy and exfoliating but still gentle
avis.texte: I really like this scrub, it makes my skin feel super soft and not dry at all after using it. It smells nice too, kind of clean and creamy. I've been using it in the shower and it leaves my skin feeling smooth which I love. Only thing is, you really gotta be careful around your eyes. A couple times it got in my eyes by accident and it burned pretty bad. So I definitely don't recommend using it close to your face or near the eyes. Other than that it works good and I'd buy again, just with that one warning.
Love this product. Makes my face feel so clean. Love your products. Try to have more sales once in awhile. Thank u

This is a pretty good cleanser. I love switching up my exfoliating cleansers so I decided to try this one. It does the job of gently exfoliating my face, but leaves it feeling smooth after. After a few uses I have not had any irritation (I have sensitive skin) so that is a win! It is a bit pricey in my opinion, but it will last you quite a while so that kinda balances it out.

avis.titre: I wanted to like it, but it made me break out every time
avis.texte: I used it around 7 times in the bath. I liked how it felt and how it smelled. However, every time I would break out after using it. I tried many times to really make sure it was this product. Not many things make me break out, but this did. I threw it out.

I have dry, insanely sensitive skin. This is one of the few face washes I have used that leaves my face feeling clean and hydrated. The jojoba beads are gentle on my skin, and I never had a reaction to it. The only thing I do not like about this face wash is the price. The price is why I only buy it when it goes on sale.

avis.titre: If you like feeling granules on your skin for hours, buy it
avis.texte: The exfoliation is fine but the granules will not wash away even with rinsing my face many times. I'm shocked by how many good reviews there are. I'll be donating this to my 12 year old niece
It's gentle but its not doing much. The skin doesn't feel clean and exfoliated after use. For this price, its not worth it.

I recently tried a different product from another company that ruined my very sensitive combination skin. After searching for a few weeks trying to find a new product that would be more pleasant on my skin, the skincare specialist at Ulta showed this cleanser scrub to me. I was skeptical at first but gave it a try. I have been using it for 4 days now. It doesn't irritate my skin at all, feels very soothing, feels gentle on my acne spots, makes my skin feel very smooth, does not dry me out, and is helping to clear my blemishes. It is great for daily use, I use it both in the morning and the evening with no issues.

I bought this because I really like the Beekman 1802 line and has always worked well with my skin. Also the reviews were good so I thought I just couldn't go wrong here. Sadly this just doesn't do it for me. The granules in it that are suppose to exfoliate the skin are way to big,few and far between, and just rolls around on your skin. I do not feel like I am getting any dead skin off or exfoliating at all. It's more like a massage. Also, the cleanser itself is so thick and heavy, I feel as if I really have to rub my face a little harder than normal to rinse it all off during the rinsing process. Also doesn't lather so I don't really know why it's called a cleanser. There's been no change for the better or the worse after using this, so I don't see myself repurchasing in the future. If it didn't cost so much I wouldn't even finish it, however I can't bring myself to throw away money. I recommend looking elsewhere for a good exfoliator.

This is hands down one of the best exfoliating scrubs I've ever gotten at Ulta. It's the right amount of exfoliation that I can use it on my sensitive face and it will remove buildup and makeup without damaging my skin.

avis.titre: First Time Buyer, but so not the last time!!
avis.texte: It's love! I have very sensitive skin and this gentle exfoliation leaves my skin feeling soft and moisturized!! Thankful this entire line up is cruelty free!! Fantastic product!!!
This would have been perfect if the jojoba spheres dissolved but they dont. I have to keep flushing my face with water several times to get my face clear of them.

Very very gentle face cleaner. So gentle it didn't remove my make up hence minus 1 star....it is super gentle which is great for mature skin and/or persons with some dermo issues. I am going to keep it & just use my reg face wash first....it does leave your skin smooth & soft.
Wonderful product! Love the entire Beekman line. This gently exfoliates without any drying issues.
I have extremely sensitive skin (acne + eczema) and this scub works perfectly! Its helped my acne as well. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: The product has goat milk and it is the GOAT
avis.texte: I'm using the Milk Scrub twice a week, sometimes even three times since it's so gentle yet effective. I love that despite being a scrub it doesn't leave your face irritated, sensitive or dry. My face afterward is honestly soooo nourished and smooth like a baby skin, I dont feel any tugging or see any redness. I also really like the very subtle scent, which makes the whole skincare routine like a mini spa at home. Sometimes it might take a bit to wash off the little balls in the scrub, but other than that I definitely would repurchase once finished.

I normally use Truly Face Scrub but the store was out. One of the associates recommended this and said it was just as good. I however disagree. My face doesn't feel clean at all, it leaves a greasy film and it's really thick. I will not be purchasing again.

I have super sensitive skin, and I loved how gentle this was yet how exfoliating it felt. I've used other rice/milk scrubs and this definitely was up there with some of the big names. Would get again in a heartbeat.
I use this product as a facial scrub/exfoliator every other day. I feel like it is gentle and effective. My skin looks and feels great after using the milk scrub.

I really do love this product. It is a great cleanser. I incorporated it into my normal skincare routine and I'm actually a fan of it I just can't get used to the scrubbing aspect of it. It's just not something my skin is used to. I recommend it to my sister to try since she loves facials scrubs.
This is a wonderful exfoliating scrub for sensitive skin. My pores seem less noticeable and my skin feels soft and hydrated. I definitely would recommend it and would purchase it

I wanted to love this, as I do most of Beekman's products but this didn't leave my face feeling clean. Pros: not too scented, doesn't irritate my sensitive skin Cons: doesn't make my skin feel clean, leaves oily film Unfortunately, I would not order this again or recommend this particular product
Had a horrible cold I needed a spa day at home. This scrub made my face feel so soft after using and woke up still feeling fresh. Smells great and not tough on skin.

avis.titre: New addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: I was a little skeptical about using a scrub on my face due to concern of microtears, but this scrub is gentle on your skin. I use it 1-2 times a week and my skin texture has improved significantly. My products are absorbed better into my skin after I use this product. It leaves my skin soft and moisturizes as you use it. Even my husband is using it after he washed his face.

avis.titre: I would totally suggest this product
avis.texte: This smells greatttt. It has a good moisturizing feel and just feels awesome. I really would suggest this to my friends

I also use the Milk Shake, Golden Booster, Dream Booster and Bloom Cream, as well as the facial wipes, lotions and whipped body creams. They are all the best skin care products I have ever used. Thank you, Beekman!

Great stuff! Feels good in use, feels even better after washing off. Wonderful product.

avis.titre: Love it Very Gentle and does the job!
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this new cleanser/exfoliator and found it not only gentle but impressed on how well it exfoliates your skin it was so clean and soft afterwards. Love the fact it has not only that wonderful goat milk, but the oats are so gentle and soothing yet effective. Would highly recommend this for anyone using a more abrasive type of exfoliator that can harm you face instead of treating it with love as intended. The big plus also being clean beauty and cruelty free. Will definitely buy again. Love all the Beekman products and so appreciate all the love and care the Beekman Boys put into their products. Keep up the good work.

I am not sure I would repurchase this product again, but it is not a bad product. It has a very, very, very light scent, which is great. It is free of fragrance, sulfates, mineral oil, alcohol, phthalates, synthetic, colorants, formaldehyde, talc and parabens. That being said, I still think the ingredient list is too long. The product has a thin yet creamy texture. Scrubs are not typically good for winter on my skin so I really don't appreciate how it made my skin feel. The only thing I really dislike is the little granules that acts as the exfoliating agent.

This is my second Beekman 1802 product that I have tried and this is definitely my favorite. I have been looking for a good exfoliation that isn't difficult to wipe off. The milk scrub not only was easy to remove but also left my face feeling the smoothest it has ever felt. I use it both in the morning and at night before I use any moisturizer or toner. I would highly recommend this product!

I had no allergic reaction to it!
